The formula used

Gratuity = 21 days × (basic salary ÷ 30) × years of service, provided one year of service is completed. Allowances are excluded, and a contract may give more. Prefer Arabic? Use the Arabic version.

Frequently asked questions

How much is gratuity for 5 years in Qatar?

105 days of basic salary (21 days per year): a basic salary of QAR 5,000 gives QAR 17,500.

Is gratuity reduced on resignation in Qatar?

No. Article 54 gives the gratuity to anyone who completes a year of service whatever the reason the contract ends, unless dismissed under Article 61.

Is there a cap on gratuity in Qatar?

The law sets no cap, and a contract may give more than three weeks per year.

Sources

  • Qatar Labour Law 14/2004 — Article 54 (Al Meezan)
